description: This is a PHP test class file for the ResetPasswordDao, part of the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It contains unit tests for methods related to password reset requests, including saving a reset request, retrieving reset logs by code, and updating reset request validity.

classes.name: ResetPasswordDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing ResetPasswordDao functionality within the OrangeHRM password reset module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating the ResetPasswordDao, setting up configuration, and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveResetPassword
methods.description: Tests the saving of a ResetPasswordRequest to the database and verifies attributes.

methods.name: testGetResetPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a reset password log entry using a reset code.

methods.name: testUpdateResetPasswordValid
methods.description: Tests updating the validity status of a reset password request for a user.
